# ui-segmented-control

> Segmented control with a sliding indicator for single-value selection.

**Class:** `UISegmentedControl`

## Attributes

| Attribute | Type | Description |
|-----------|------|-------------|
| `value` | `string` | Currently selected segment value |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | Disables all segments |
| `name` | `string` | Form field name |

## Events

| Event | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| `ui-change` | Fired when selection changes with `{ value, label }` detail |

## Usage

```html
<ui-segmented-control></ui-segmented-control>
```
